pages.title: Icicle
pages.text: From $(bold)Phase 4$() icicles grow under snow, ice, frozen dirt and log overhangs. Each grows through four lengths.$(br2)They block movement and mobs path around them. Break the roof above and they fall away.

pages.title: Volcanic Ash
pages.text: Settles in layers around active vents and volcanic fields. It never freezes.$(br2)Soft and quick to dig. Deep ash marks a vent that is still erupting.

pages.title: Scorched Ground
pages.text: Burnt crust left by blast pits and rupture vents. It never freezes over.$(br2)It glows faintly in the dark. Any tool digs it, slowly.

pages.title: Field Note
pages.text: $(flavor)Rule of thumb: if the ground isn't white, something underneath is still warm. Find out what before you sleep on it.$()
